card.name: Words just before a named chemical agent
card.fires_on: Linking words or word parts right before a named chemical, herbicide, compound or topical agent, such as 'such as', 'treated with', 'form of', 'contains'. Often in garden, farm or topical-treatment text.

modes.label: Herbicide and chemical lists
modes.description: Words in or just before a list of named herbicides or chemicals.
modes.example: Controversy exists around the use of herbicides more commonly used by home gardeners, such as, 2,4-D<< and>> Roundup.

modes.label: Linking word before a treatment
modes.description: Small words like with, such, of, contains that lead into a named treatment or ingredient.
modes.example: most of the mature green tomatoes produced in California are packed and then treated<< with>> ethylene

modes.label: Inside treatment words
modes.description: Endings of words describing a compound or topical product.
modes.example: Powder<<ed>> compound goes a long way
